record.field: {{ object.company_id.name or user.company_id.name }} - Customer Registration (KYC) Form
Sent to a new customer with the blank KYC form to fill in and return.

div.p: Thank you for your interest in working with aHPS.

To register you as a customer, please complete the attached Know Your Customer (KYC) form, including the contact details of your procurement and finance departments, and return the signed form to us by email together with a copy of your company registration certificate.
Once your registration is approved, we will share your customer ID, which will appear on all our quotations and invoices.
